purpose: Executable-facing contract cards for the first two vertical combat slices.

kaze.fantasy: Short-window execution assassin with a readable entry and a costly miss.
kaze.winCondition: Reach an isolated or weakened target, convert the dash into a combo finisher, then disengage before the reset window closes.
kaze.counterplay: Hold spacing, punish the missed dash, survive the first combo and deny the low-health execution.
kaze.soloAcceptance: A correct dash against a 30% HP target creates a kill window; a missed dash does not grant a free reset or immunity.
kaze.teamAcceptance: Kaze creates a focused pick without replacing a frontliner; the team can follow the entry but must cover the retreat.

basic.impact: Two short slashes advance the combo; the third combo hit is the only empowered basic hit.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent, no combo progress is granted, and no reset is created.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before the active window cancels the slash.

super.impact: One hit per target during the dash; hit applies stun and primes the follow-up. Kill resets the super cooldown only.
super.missOutcome: The dash travels and the Super is consumed; no stun, prime or reset is awarded.
super.interrupt: Stun before dash activation cancels the cast; after activation the dash resolves once.

gadget.impact: Kaze becomes hidden and prepares one guaranteed critical first hit.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and stealth expires normally even if no target is found.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the cast; damage does not cancel the active stealth early.

katty.fantasy: Paint-based space controller who converts setup into zones and safe movement.
katty.winCondition: Layer paint in a contested route, force an enemy response, then use the zone or flight trail to close or escape.
katty.counterplay: Leave the painted zone during telegraph, avoid the third layer, and punish Katty when flight ends or a trail is wasted.
katty.soloAcceptance: Katty wins space through visible setup and a fair exit window; direct basic trading alone does not delete a full-health target.
katty.teamAcceptance: Katty creates a choke and enables a teammate's engage, but her zone does not replace allied damage or become unavoidable cover.

basic.impact: Short spray applies one paint layer; the third layer adds the stun and damage conversion.
basic.missOutcome: Ammo is spent and no paint layer is created outside the cone.
basic.interrupt: Stun or cast lock before active cancels the spray.

super.impact: The marked area applies a visible pull/slow and one paint conversion; damage starts after telegraph completion.
super.missOutcome: The zone is consumed at the selected point and can be left before impact; no target receives damage or status outside the area.
super.interrupt: Stun before deployment cancels the throw; after deployment the zone remains until expiry.

gadget.impact: Katty gains flight speed and leaves a readable trail; touching the trail detonates it once.
gadget.missOutcome: Charge is spent and flight ends without trail detonation if no enemy touches the trail.
gadget.interrupt: Stun before activation rejects the gadget; active flight ends at its timer and does not grant immunity.
